record.reason: The week-12 note makes this a timely revisit, and the candidate correctly says HRV and other wearable data cannot determine whether muscle has increased. It proposes a direct, proportionate measurement—circumference compared with a comparable baseline—and explains how that could inform whether to continue or track further, while noting that a single change cannot confirm muscle gain. No causal claim or repetition of a previously surfaced insight is present.
